films.scope: Local actual Chrome QA; desktop mobile/touch emulation. No current HTTPS verification yet.
films.versionQualification: Full functional/loop matrix and solo retakes exercised v2 index f467167d; final v3 783ec4351 differs by favicon link only. Removing the one favicon tag reconstructs byte-exact v2; source/CSS/body/controller/media unchanged. Short headed hidden and frame probes exercised final v3.
films.callbackThresholdQualification: Original >=380 callback assertion failed for two simultaneous desktop-home films: 314/317 callbacks with 533/532 total-video frames, and separate solo retakes 308/308 with 530/529. Raw failures retained. Low callbacks are not attributed solely to parallel QA. A new 3s headed/headless probe measured 71–73 presentedFrames increments and 72 total/decoded frames but only 42–51 callbacks, with many presentedFrames +2 hops. This supports callback coalescing in this Chrome environment, not a claim of physical-display pixel-perfect playback.
films.visibilityQualification: Actual hidden state could not be induced in owned headless or headed Chrome by another tab or window minimization: document.hidden=false, visibilityState=visible, no visibilitychange events. Real background pause is unverified here. Configurable document.hidden override plus visibilitychange simulation passed. Original actual-hidden failed assertions preserved as an unmet environment precondition.
otherLimitations: No physical phones, Safari or physical display cadence tested.
Autoplay denial is controlled NotAllowedError injection while native userActivation.isActive is false, followed by actual Chrome click retry.
Film placement was programmatic scrollIntoView; native touch/wheel/keyboard broad functional QA belongs to the separate surface report.
totalVideoFrames is reported by getVideoPlaybackQuality; webkitDecodedFrameCount was independently sampled in the short probe, not every long trial.

actualHiddenFocusEmulationDisabledAttemp.classification: Unmet environment precondition; no product pass or fail assigned to real hidden behavior

historical_natural_scroll_publication.title: Cendovari Webdesign Sida — godkänt naturligt scrollflöde
historical_natural_scroll_publication.status: Godkänd och publicerad på GitHub Pages; HTTPS-källa/export verifierade byteexakt och publika webbläsarkontroller passerade.
changes: Startsidan rör sig direkt med scroll; den långa fasta förvandlingsscenen är borttagen.
Stora vertikala filmkort följer direkt efter startsidan, med begränsad tillväxt/parallax och alltid tillgänglig text och knappar.
Dator och mobil visas tillsammans under en gemensam rubrik; startsidans fasstyrande kontroller är dolda och inaktiva.
Mobilillustrationens inre grid och textradbrytning hindrar klippning vid smala bredder.
Naturlig scrollcontroller har en ägare, städar listeners/observers, samlar frames och räknar geometri utan skalningsåterkoppling.
Ny controller gör inga geometrimätningar när startsidan är dold, inert, under öppen meny, pausad/reducerad eller i bakgrund/pagehide.
Kristallens tidsanimation pausar offscreen/meny/bakgrund; ljusförflyttning är begränsad till startsidans höjd.
Kontaktutkastets befintliga iframe-fix är bevarad och Enter efter redigering rättad: fältets change slutförs före utkastvisning och fokusflytt.
preserved: Mobilmeny, fokus, navigation, projektöppning, Tillbaka/Escape och scrollåterställning.
Kontaktens publicerade iframe-fix, validering, Enter/textarea, lokalt utkast och manuell kopiering.

Alla tio medieposter, fem runtime/exporterfiler, noindex,nofollow och sandbox.
Märkning av illustrationsfilmer och tillfälliga företagsnamn; inga nya kundpåståenden.

historical_review.scope: New inline preview only. Accepted previews, original videos, export project, live website, WordPress, GitHub and Modbus Buddy untouched.
changes: Project image grows from its captured card frame into the opened concept image, then blends out. Native navigation, focus, scroll, Back and Escape remain authoritative.
Soft pointer reflection over featured and gallery image surfaces, only for mouse/fine-pointer motion-enabled previews. No idle animation loop.
Front-face crystal reflection reuses pointer coordinates and existing canvas scheduling; exactly two clipped main-logo front faces receive light without geometry or timeline changes.
Existing service form-study shapes now use original C/V brand proportions with CSS, without added markup or animations.
Two single-shot video trims replace rapid montages; 960x540 at 24fps with milder compression, matching first-frame posters in all six image placements.
Shorter unique root namespace keeps the preview at 890296 bytes without minifying native controllers.
checks: 27 unique IDs, valid labels and ARIA relationships, valid fragment nesting, 18 script syntax checks and 2027 scoped CSS selector branches.
Actual-tree synthetic PB/Motor gallery and homepage route, one expansion per open, native Back/Escape/focus/scroll preserved.
Pointer bounds, frame coalescing, touch/pen exclusion, pause/reduced/hidden/inert/offscreen gates, style restoration and detach cleanup.
Canvas mesh, paths, transforms, base fills and scheduled frames match baseline at 320, 736 and 1024 widths across eight scroll poses.
Final film first/middle/last frames inspected; codec, frame rate, dimensions, audio removal, faststart, poster payloads and source alignment verified.
13 protected files remain hash-identical. 14 native scripts match baseline exactly after root normalization; native video controller differs only in source payloads.
Independent focused source and synthetic integration review found no blocker.
limits: No browser rendering or video playback test; inline preview is the visual review surface.
The two videos repeat after roughly one second. Small physical pose resets remain; they are not claimed perfectly seamless.
Illustration films and temporary company names remain labeled as design concepts. No real photographs were supplied.
Mobile navigation redesign remains deferred. New transition decoration is disabled below 720px.
